title: My good friend
simplified_paragraphs: 我的好朋友名字叫陈陈。他喜欢喝酒，我喜欢运动。小学和中学，我们都是一个班的同学。大学我们不在一个学校，但是我们还在一个城市生活。后来他去了杭州工作，我去了上海，但是我们还是经常见面。
traditional_paragraphs: 我的好朋友名字叫陳陳。他喜歡喝酒，我喜歡運動。小學和中學，我們都是一個班的同學。大學我們不在一個學校，但是我們還在一個城市生活。後來他去了杭州工作，我去了上海，但是我們還是經常見面。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ de hǎo péng you míng zi jiào Chén Chén。 tā xǐ huan hē jiǔ， wǒ xǐ huan yùn dòng。 xiǎo xué hé zhōng xué， wǒ men dōu shì yī gè bān de tóng xué。 dà xué wǒ men bù zài yī gè xué xiào， dàn shì wǒ men hái zài yī gè chéng shì shēng huó。 hòu lái tā qù le Háng zhōu gōng zuò， wǒ qù le Shàng hǎi， dàn shì wǒ men hái shi jīng cháng jiàn miàn。
english_paragraphs: My good friend's name is Chen Chen. He likes to drink and I like to play sports. In primary school and middle school, we were all classmates in the same class. We are not in the same university, but we still live in the same city. Later he went to Hangzhou to work and I went to Shanghai, but we still met often.
english_full: My good friend's name is Chen Chen. He likes to drink and I like to play sports. In primary school and middle school, we were all classmates in the same class. We are not in the same university, but we still live in the same city. Later he went to Hangzhou to work and I went to Shanghai, but we still met often.
